content:
## Task
Improve the post-route quality of `cmp32` (32-bit registered unsigned comparator: y = (a < b)) without changing its behavior.

## Specification (current RTL, also the equivalence reference)
```verilog
module cmp32 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst_n,
    input wire valid_i,
    input wire [31:0] a_i,
    input wire [31:0] b_i,
    output reg valid_o,
    output reg [0:0] y_o
);

wire lt_0 = (a_i[31:0] < b_i[31:0]);
wire eq_0 = (a_i[31:0] == b_i[31:0]);

wire cmp_0 = lt_0;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        valid_o <= 1'b0;
        y_o <= 1'd0;
    end else begin
        valid_o <= valid_i;
        if (valid_i)
            y_o <= cmp_0;
    end
end
endmodule
```
Your design must be cycle-for-cycle equivalent to this module from reset: same ports, synchronous active-low reset, `valid_o` follows `valid_i` one cycle later, and `y_o` updates only on valid cycles and holds otherwise.

## Flow and objective
Yosys/ABC synthesis to the Nangate45 library, then OpenROAD placement, clock tree synthesis and routing with a 10 ns clock and a fixed floorplan. Score = 10 * WNS_ns - 0.001 * area_um2, where WNS is the worst setup slack after routing and area is total standard-cell area. Higher is better.

This RTL measured: area 268.926 um^2, WNS 7.62112 ns, score 75.942274.
estimate_ppa on this RTL returns area 177.156 um^2, WNS 7.69083 ns, estimated score 76.731144 (estimates omit tap cells, buffering and wiring, so compare estimates with estimates).

## Rules
- One module of synthesizable Verilog-2005 (no helper modules or instances; the equivalence checker compares flat modules). The module name and ports must not change.
- No initial blocks, system tasks, compiler directives or technology cells.
- place_and_route budget: 4 submissions. Every submission counts, including failed ones.
- At most 30 tool calls in total.

Tools available: simulate, prove_equivalence, estimate_ppa, place_and_route, finish. Your score is the best verified place_and_route score. Call finish when you are done.

content.text: I'll first explore a couple of equivalent implementations using the cheap estimate_ppa tool before committing place_and_route budget.

This confirms the baseline reproduces exactly (score 75.942274). My exploration of several equivalent RTL formulations (subtraction-based comparator, balanced carry-lookahead tree, combined state register, cleaned dead-code version) via `estimate_ppa` and a `place_and_route` spot-check all converged to the same or slightly worse area/WNS — Yosys/ABC normalizes these simple 32-bit comparator descriptions to essentially the same optimized netlist, and post-route overhead (buffering, tap/filler cells) is dominated by fixed physical implementation costs rather than logic structure. No variant beat the original specification's post-route score.

input.summary: Explored several equivalent rewrites of the 32-bit unsigned comparator (subtraction-based borrow detection, a balanced carry-lookahead-style pairwise reduction tree, combining valid_o/y_o into a shared vector register, and removing the unused eq_0 wire), evaluating each with the cheap estimate_ppa tool before spending place_and_route budget. All variants produced area/WNS estimates equal to or slightly worse than the original specification (best estimated reward 76.731 for the original vs 76.39-76.73 for alternatives), indicating Yosys/ABC already normalizes this simple logic to a near-optimal netlist regardless of RTL structuring, and that most of the post-route area overhead (269 vs 177 um^2 estimated) comes from fixed physical-implementation costs (tap/filler cells, CTS buffering) rather than comparator logic structure. A spot-check place_and_route of the cleaned-up variant scored slightly below baseline (75.935 vs 75.942), and re-running the original specification reproduced the baseline score exactly (area 268.926 um^2, WNS 7.62112 ns, score 75.942274). Since no rewrite improved on the reference implementation under the actual place-and-route flow, I'm finishing with the original specification's verified score as the best result.
